全場站行李異常概況：延誤/遺失與破損案件、成因拆解、熱點航班與賠償結構，另含超重行李（EB）收入、預算執行與年度同期比較。金額依公司官方月匯率換算台幣。資料涵蓋 2026 年 1–9 月（九個完整月份）。本版各區塊隨上方篩選器即時重算——月份、類型、場站三個條件會同時作用。Network-wide baggage mishandling overview: delayed / missing and damaged cases, cause breakdown, hotspot flights and compensation mix, plus excess baggage (EB) revenue, budget vs actual and the year-on-year comparison. Amounts are converted to New Taiwan dollars at the company's official monthly FX rates. Data covers Jan–Sep 2026 (nine complete months). Sections recalculate live with the filters above—month, type and station all apply at the same time.

01

每月行李異常率走勢（含 3 個月平均與警戒範圍）Monthly Mishandled Baggage Rate (with 3-Month Average and Alert Range)

怎麼看：藍線是每個月的託運行李異常比率（每千件託運行李有幾件受影響）。 褐色虛線是「最近三個月的平均」，用來把單月的上下震盪抹平、只看大方向。 三條水平線是警戒範圍：中間那條是全期平均，上下兩條是統計上的正常波動邊界。 意義：線落在上下兩條之間，代表這是正常的起伏；一旦衝出邊界，才是真的出事、需要回頭查那個月發生什麼。How to read it: The blue line is the checked bag irregularity rate for each month — how many affected bags per 1,000 checked bags. The bronze dashed line is the average of the most recent three months, which smooths out month-to-month swings so only the broad direction shows. The three horizontal lines are the alert range: the middle one is the full-period average, and the upper and lower lines are the statistical boundaries of normal variation. What it means: A point between the upper and lower lines is normal fluctuation. Only when the line breaks past a boundary has something genuinely gone wrong, and that month is worth going back to investigate.

02

破損率走勢（每千件行李）Damage Rate Trend (/1,000 Bags)

用途：破損案占本網全部異常的四分之三，是總異常率的主要驅動力，因此值得單獨拉出來看。 分母用「行李件數」而非旅客數，因為破損是發生在行李上、不是發生在人身上。 意義：把它跟上一張並排看就能判斷——如果總異常率在降、破損率也在降，那是同一件事； 如果總異常率降但破損率持平，代表下降來自延誤側，成因完全不同。Purpose: Damaged bags account for three quarters of all mishandling on this network and are the main driver of the overall rate, so they are worth isolating. The denominator here is bags handled rather than passengers, because damage happens to a bag, not to a person. What it means: Read side by side with the previous chart. If the overall rate is falling and the damage rate is falling too, they are the same story. If the overall rate falls while the damage rate stays flat, the decline is coming from the delayed side, and the causes are entirely different.

美國五站 vs 其餘全場站 逐月異常率The Five U.S. Stations vs the Rest of the Network — Monthly Mishandled Baggage Rate

用途：美國五站（SEA／LAX／SFO／PHX／ONT）只占全場站託運行李 7.8%，卻占受影響行李近三成（29.5%）， 比率是全場站的 3.8 倍。這張圖追蹤這個差距是在收斂還是擴大。 意義：這是「以美國線起程站為單位重整收運與配載決策」這項措施的成效追蹤指標。 兩條線的距離縮小才代表措施有效；如果兩條線一起下降，那只是全場站共同因素、不是美國線的改善。Purpose: The five U.S. stations (SEA / LAX / SFO / PHX / ONT) carry only 7.8% of network checked bags yet account for 29.5% of affected bags, at a rate 3.8 times the network average. This chart tracks whether that gap is closing or widening. What it means: This is the tracking indicator for the measure to restructure acceptance and load planning decisions around the U.S. departure stations. Only a narrowing gap between the two lines shows the measure is working. If both lines fall together, that is a factor common to the whole network, not an improvement on the U.S. routes.

07

案件數前五大起程站 逐月託運行李異常比率Monthly Checked Bag Irregularity Rate — Top Five Departure Stations by Cases

用途：用統一縱軸把案件數最多的五個起程站畫在一起，看它們的相對位置如何隨月變化。 意義：這張圖取代了先前表格裡的迷你走勢線——迷你走勢線的縱軸是各站自己的範圍， 只能看方向、不能比高低；統一縱軸之後，「哪一站正在超車」一眼就看得出來， 這才是排優先順序時真正需要的資訊。 本圖固定以起程站歸戶（選站與畫線同口徑），與其餘趨勢圖一致，不隨上方「場站口徑」切換而變。 備註：3 月洛杉磯場站有回報行李滾帶壞掉導致大量行李無法上機。Purpose: Plots the five departure stations with the most cases on a single shared vertical axis, showing how their positions relative to one another shift from month to month. What it means: This chart replaces the sparklines used in the earlier table. A sparkline scales its axis to each station's own range, so it shows direction but not level. On a shared axis, which station is overtaking another is visible at a glance — and that is what is actually needed when setting priorities. This chart is always assigned on a departure station basis (station selection and plotting use the same basis), consistent with the other trend charts, and does not change with the station basis switch above. Note: LAX reported in March that a baggage conveyor belt failure prevented a large number of bags from being loaded.

10

延誤成因結構逐月占比Monthly Mix by Delay Cause

用途：把延誤案依 IATA 官方成因大類拆開看逐月消長：轉機他航、營運／設備／天候、 拿錯／安檢、未能裝載、裝卸錯誤等。 意義：不同成因對應完全不同的責任單位與改善手段。轉機類要對外談 SLA、營運類要查設備與配載、 安檢類要跟機場端協調。看占比而非件數，是為了排除總量變動的干擾—— 即使總延誤件數在降，某一類的占比上升仍代表那一塊在惡化。Purpose: Breaks delayed cases into the official IATA cause categories and tracks how each moves month by month: transfer mishandling; airport / customs / weather / space-weight restriction; ticketing error / bag switch / security / other; failure to load; loading error. What it means: Each cause points to a different owner and a different remedy. Transfer cases are an SLA conversation with partners. Operational cases mean checking equipment and load planning. Security cases require coordination with the airport. Shares are shown instead of counts to strip out the effect of changing volume — even when total delayed cases are falling, a rising share in one category still means that category is getting worse.

跨航分攤通知（Prorate Notice）狀態逐月Monthly Status of Interline Prorate Notices

用途：呈現 Interline Prorate Control List 的分攤通知狀態與金額。 這份表和跨航理賠追蹤使用的 Delivery Control List 一樣，都是我方向他航求償的控管表——他航應該付錢給我們。 意義：「結案」是已談妥分攤；「資料收集中」是還在補件、仍可追回； 「已過期」代表超過求償期限，這筆錢恐怕已收不回來；「不拆／被拒」是他航拒絕分攤。Purpose: Shows the status and amounts of prorate notices in the Interline Prorate Control List. Like the Delivery Control List used for interline claims tracking, this is a control list of claims we raise against other carriers — money the other carrier should pay us. What it means: "Closed" means the proration has been agreed; "collecting documentation" means the claim is still being supported and can still be recovered; "expired" means the claim deadline has passed and the money is probably no longer recoverable; "not prorated / refused" means the other carrier declined to share the cost.

重點KEY POINT2026 年與 2025 年同季相比，託運行李異常比率 Q1 −16.6%（3.30 → 2.75‰）、Q2 −3.3%（2.34 → 2.26‰）、Q3 +12.4%（2.16 → 2.43‰）；航班架次 Q3 由 2024 年 5,765 班增至 2026 年 7,869 班。Against the same quarter of 2025, the 2026 checked bag irregularity rate is -16.6% in Q1 (3.30 to 2.75), -3.3% in Q2 (2.34 to 2.26) and +12.4% in Q3 (2.16 to 2.43 per 1,000 bags); Q3 flights grew from 5,765 in 2024 to 7,869 in 2026.

營運量能與資料品質趨勢Capacity and Data Quality Trends

分母端與資料可信度The denominator side and data credibility

重點KEY POINT託運行李由 1 月 519,068 件增至 9 月 550,186 件（+6.0%），受影響行李由 1,542 件減為 1,364 件（−11.5%）——本期下降不只是分母變大，件數本身也減少；寫異常率時件數仍要一起看。Checked bags rose from 519,068 in January to 550,186 in September (+6.0%) while affected bags fell from 1,542 to 1,364 (-11.5%) — the decline this period is not only a larger denominator, the counts themselves fell; counts should still always be read together with the rate.

各月案件結案率（資料成熟度）Monthly Case Closure Rate (Data Maturity)

意義：這張圖決定哪幾個月的金額可以相信。 結案率未達 95% 的月份，其賠償金額必然被低估，任何跨月的金額比較都會失真。What it means: This chart determines which months' amounts can be trusted. In any month whose closure rate is below 95%, compensation is necessarily understated, and any cross-month comparison of amounts will be distorted.

15

受影響行李件數 vs 案件數逐月Monthly Bags Affected vs Cases

用途：一件案件可能牽涉多件行李。本期起各項比率改以受影響的行李件數計算， 這張圖把它與案件數並列。 意義：兩條線的距離就是「每案平均行李件數」。 對旅客服務而言案件數是對的單位（一個旅客一個案）， 但對作業負荷與賠付風險而言行李件數才是對的單位。 若兩線開始分岔，代表多件行李的案件變多，單件處理成本會上升。Purpose: A single case can involve more than one bag. From this period the rates are calculated on affected bags; this chart places them alongside the number of cases. What it means: The gap between the two lines is the average number of bags per case. For passenger service, cases are the right unit — one passenger, one case. For handling load and payout exposure, bags are the right unit. If the two lines begin to diverge, multi-bag cases are becoming more common and the cost of handling each case will rise.
